# LevelPace uploader configuration.
#
# Line 1 (required)  where to SEND stats
# Line 2 (optional)  submission token, if the board requires one
# Line 3 (optional)  where to READ the rankings from
#
# Only the person handing this folder out edits it. Recipients never do.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# READING is already solved with no domain and no server: GitHub Pages serves
# the board publicly. That is what fills in /lp board in game. Leave line 3 as
# it is unless you move the site.
#
# SENDING is the part that needs somewhere to reach. Pick one:
#
#   Tailscale (no domain, free)   http://100.x.y.z:8080
#   Cloudflare Tunnel (a domain)  https://levelpace.example.com
#   Same network only             http://192.168.1.20:8080
#   Nothing yet                   leave the default; uploads will simply fail
#                                 and the board still reads fine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

http://localhost:8080

# token goes here on its own line if you set one on the server
